explanation: Generated 25 physically valid eta points at W=1.6 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0, with phi*=0..345 degrees in 25 evenly spaced points. Inputs were chunked into 10, 10, and 5 points. Full O(alpha) radiative corrections and the default vcut=0.166 GeV^2 were used. Beam energy was not specified, so the validated eta campaign default of 6.53 GeV was used; radiative corrections depend on beam energy.
